WITH coverage_periods AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Effective_Date AS start_date,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium
  FROM policy AS p
  JOIN policy_amount AS pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
  JOIN premium AS pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
  GROUP BY pa.Effective_Date
)
SELECT
  start_date,
  annual_premium,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * (annual_premium - LAG(annual_premium) OVER (ORDER BY start_date))
    / NULLIF(LAG(annual_premium) OVER (ORDER BY start_date), 0),
    2
  ) AS premium_change_pct
FROM coverage_periods
ORDER BY start_date;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '0-5 miles'
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 miles'
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '11-15 miles'
        ELSE 'More than 15 miles'
    END AS distance_band,
    COUNT(*) AS claim_count,
    AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim
WHERE Nearest_Firestation_miles >= 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY MIN(
    CASE
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 5 THEN 1
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 10 THEN 2
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 15 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END
);

SELECT
  CAST(FLOOR(Year_Built / 10.0) * 10 AS INTEGER)::VARCHAR || 's' AS decade_built,
  AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio,
  COUNT(*) AS claim_count
FROM fire_claim
WHERE Year_Built IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY FLOOR(Year_Built / 10.0)
ORDER BY FLOOR(Year_Built / 10.0);

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE Loss_Ratio >= 1.0)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage_of_fire_claims
FROM fire_claim;

SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(Fireplace)) = 'yes' THEN Loss_Ratio END)
    - AVG(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(Fireplace)) = 'no' THEN Loss_Ratio END) AS average_loss_ratio_difference
FROM fire_claim;

SELECT corr(Number_of_Firefighters, Loss_Ratio) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM fire_claim;

WITH annual_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Effective_Date AS period_start,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium
    FROM policy AS p
    JOIN policy_amount AS pa
        ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN premium AS pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
    GROUP BY pa.Effective_Date
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(period_start) AS first_start,
        MAX(period_start) AS latest_start,
        ARG_MIN(annual_premium, period_start) AS first_premium,
        ARG_MAX(annual_premium, period_start) AS latest_premium
    FROM annual_premiums
)
SELECT
    POWER(
        latest_premium::DOUBLE / NULLIF(first_premium, 0),
        365.25 / NULLIF(DATE_DIFF('day', first_start, latest_start), 0)
    ) - 1 AS compound_annual_growth_rate
FROM periods;

SELECT
  Number_of_Firefighters,
  AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS Average_Loss_Ratio
FROM fire_claim
WHERE Number_of_Firefighters IS NOT NULL
  AND Loss_Ratio IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Number_of_Firefighters
ORDER BY Average_Loss_Ratio ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    MEDIAN(Loss_Ratio) FILTER (WHERE Year_Built >= 2000) AS median_loss_ratio_2000_or_later,
    MEDIAN(Loss_Ratio) FILTER (WHERE Year_Built < 2000) AS median_loss_ratio_before_2000
FROM fire_claim;

answer.sql:
SELECT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    date_diff('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Open_Date) AS days_incident_to_open,
    date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) AS days_open_to_close,
    100.0 * date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)
        / NULLIF(date_diff('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date), 0)
        AS percent_time_open
FROM claim AS c
LEFT JOIN occurrences AS o
    ON c.Occurrence_Identifier = o.Occurrence_Identifier;

WITH incurred_losses AS (
    SELECT SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS amount
    FROM claim AS c
    JOIN claim_amount AS ca
      ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date >= DATE '2019-01-01'
      AND c.Claim_Open_Date < DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND (
          EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM loss_payment AS lp
              WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
          )
          OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM loss_reserve AS lr
              WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
          )
      )
),
earned_premium AS (
    SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS amount
    FROM policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN premium AS p
      ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
        WHERE pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
          AND pcd.Effective_Date >= DATE '2019-01-01'
          AND pcd.Effective_Date < DATE '2020-01-01'
    )
)
SELECT incurred_losses.amount / NULLIF(earned_premium.amount, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM incurred_losses
CROSS JOIN earned_premium;

WITH claim_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment lp
      WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    ) OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve lr
      WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    ) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_loss,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM expense_payment ep
      WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    ) OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM expense_reserve er
      WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    ) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
  FROM claim_amount ca
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
  COALESCE(ct.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
  COALESCE(ct.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
  100.0 * COALESCE(ct.total_expense, 0) / NULLIF(ct.total_loss, 0) AS expense_pct_of_loss
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN catastrophe cat
  ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_totals ct
  ON ct.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier;

answer.sql:
WITH coverage_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        pa.Effective_Date,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
    FROM policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN premium AS pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, pa.Effective_Date
),
coverage_claims AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        Effective_Date,
        Claim_Identifier
    FROM claim_coverage
),
loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN loss_payment AS lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN loss_reserve AS lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
),
coverage_losses AS (
    SELECT
        cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        cc.Effective_Date,
        COALESCE(SUM(la.Claim_Amount), 0) AS incurred_loss
    FROM coverage_claims AS cc
    LEFT JOIN loss_amounts AS la
        ON la.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, cc.Effective_Date
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    pcd.Effective_Date AS coverage_start_date,
    cp.premium,
    cl.incurred_loss,
    cl.incurred_loss * 1.0 / NULLIF(cp.premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
JOIN policy AS p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN coverage_losses AS cl
    ON cl.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND cl.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
LEFT JOIN coverage_premium AS cp
    ON cp.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND cp.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, pcd.Effective_Date;

WITH agent_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.Person_Identifier,
        p.First_Name,
        p.Last_Name,
        pol.Policy_Identifier
    FROM person AS p
    JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr
      ON apr.Party_Identifier = p.Person_Identifier
    JOIN policy AS pol
      ON pol.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(apr.Party_Role_Code)) = 'AGENT'
),
policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN premium AS pr
      ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
      ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN claim_amount AS ca
      ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN loss_payment AS lp
      ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
),
policy_losses AS (
    SELECT
        Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_paid
    FROM policy_loss_amounts
    GROUP BY Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    ap.First_Name,
    ap.Last_Name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.Policy_Identifier) AS distinct_policies_sold,
    SUM(COALESCE(pp.total_premium, 0)) AS total_premium,
    SUM(COALESCE(pl.total_loss_paid, 0)) AS total_loss_paid
FROM agent_policies AS ap
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums AS pp
  ON pp.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_losses AS pl
  ON pl.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY ap.Person_Identifier, ap.First_Name, ap.Last_Name
ORDER BY ap.Last_Name, ap.First_Name;

WITH claim_cost AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_cost
  FROM claim_amount AS ca
  WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
  )
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  la.Postal_Code AS zip_code,
  SUM(COALESCE(cc.total_cost, 0)) AS total_claim_cost,
  AVG(date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)) AS average_days_open_to_close
FROM claim AS c
JOIN insurable_object AS io
  ON c.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN geographic_location AS gl
  ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN location_address AS la
  ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_cost AS cc
  ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY la.Postal_Code
ORDER BY la.Postal_Code;

SELECT
    pe.First_Name,
    pe.Last_Name,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium,
    COUNT(*) AS coverage_periods,
    AVG(pa.Policy_Amount) AS average_premium_per_coverage_period
FROM person AS pe
JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr
    ON apr.Party_Identifier = pe.Person_Identifier
JOIN party_role AS pr
    ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN policy AS po
    ON po.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN policy_amount AS pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = po.Policy_Identifier
JOIN premium AS pm
    ON pm.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%policy%holder%'
GROUP BY pe.Person_Identifier, pe.First_Name, pe.Last_Name;

answer.sql:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    date_diff('day', a.End_Date, p.Effective_Date) AS Days_To_Policy_Effective_Date,
    pe.First_Name AS Underwriter_First_Name,
    pe.Last_Name AS Underwriter_Last_Name,
    ar.Assessment_Result_Type_Code AS Assessment_Result
FROM policy AS p
LEFT JOIN agreement_assessment AS aa
    ON aa.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN assessment AS a
    ON a.Assessment_Identifier = aa.Assessment_Identifier
LEFT JOIN assesment_party_role AS apr
    ON apr.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
    AND (
        apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE '%underwriter%'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM party_role AS pr
            WHERE pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
              AND pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%underwriter%'
        )
    )
LEFT JOIN person AS pe
    ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN assessment_result AS ar
    ON ar.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
LEFT JOIN underwriting_assessment AS ua
    ON ua.Assessment_Result_Identifier = ar.Assessment_Result_Identifier
WHERE ua.Assessment_Result_Identifier IS NOT NULL;

WITH claim_losses AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment lp
      WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    ) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_paid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve lr
      WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    ) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserved
  FROM claim_amount ca
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  ct.Catastrophe_Identifier,
  ct.Catastrophe_Name,
  COUNT(*) AS number_of_claims,
  SUM(COALESCE(cl.loss_paid, 0)) AS total_loss_paid,
  SUM(COALESCE(cl.loss_reserved, 0)) AS total_loss_reserved,
  100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(cl.loss_paid, 0))
    / NULLIF(
        SUM(COALESCE(cl.loss_paid, 0) + COALESCE(cl.loss_reserved, 0)),
        0
      ) AS paid_share_of_incurred_loss_pct
FROM catastrophe ct
JOIN claim c
  ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = ct.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_losses cl
  ON cl.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY ct.Catastrophe_Identifier, ct.Catastrophe_Name
ORDER BY ct.Catastrophe_Identifier;

answer.sql:
WITH claim_properties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Insurable_Object_Identifier
    FROM claim
    WHERE Insurable_Object_Identifier IS NOT NULL
),
incurred AS (
    SELECT c.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
           SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
    FROM claim c
    JOIN claim_amount ca
      ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
premiums AS (
    SELECT pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
           SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM premium p
        WHERE p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
property_ratios AS (
    SELECT io.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
           la.Line_1_Address AS street_address,
           COALESCE(i.incurred_loss, 0) AS incurred_loss,
           p.total_premium,
           COALESCE(i.incurred_loss, 0)::DOUBLE
               / NULLIF(p.total_premium, 0) AS loss_to_premium_ratio
    FROM claim_properties cp
    JOIN insurable_object io
      ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier = cp.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN geographic_location gl
      ON gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier = io.Geographic_Location_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN location_address la
      ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN incurred i
      ON i.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN premiums p
      ON p.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
